scope: Validation-only, sanitized recorded REAL source groups. No product/docs/tests/Git/settings/audio/model/paid-API changes and no VRChat/SteamVR interaction.
window: FletDesktopRendererWindow (default real Flet desktop view, not mock renderer)
publication_seam: Recorded SourceChild raw text, source identity/order/range/revision, and FinalSpeakerRun fields -> existing child Transcript pattern -> PeerSpeakerIdentityAllocator -> OverlayEventAdapter.transcript_final/utterance_closed -> OverlayPresenter.emit_peer_when_admissible -> LocalAuthenticatedRawIngress -> actual default DesktopOverlayRenderer/FletDesktopRendererWindow.
publication_limits: SourceChild settings/origins were not rehydrated; this does not repeat source partition/ownership/model/provider validation.

No translation event or translation call was made. Existing source-only presenter mapping promotes original text into the primary slot; its internal caption-plan role is named peer_translation even though these pixels contain only recorded source text.

Baseline and candidate each use a fresh presenter/allocator with the existing default two-row selection, one-second replacement pacing, and TTL. No #217 aggregation or TTL changes. The renderer remains the same owned instance; revision remapping only preserves monotonic ingress revisions across the isolated comparison.
Recorded display_group_id is retained as evidence; it is not a new display grouping implementation.

capture_safety.method: Actual screen pixels using Win32 BitBlt, bounded before reading to the owned renderer client rectangle over an opaque owned checkerboard.
capture_safety.guard: Before each pixel read, verifies renderer/backdrop HWND ownership, full opaque owned-backdrop coverage, overlay above backdrop, and no intersecting visible foreign HWND above backdrop. Only own windows are reasserted topmost, without activation or move/hide operations on foreign windows.
capture_safety.ingress: Authenticated 127.0.0.1 ephemeral WebSocket, authentication token not retained.
capture_safety.composition: Direct task-local diagnostic startup. Ordinary main/application composition and user settings are never invoked. Renderer is persistence-free.

observation_method: All seven PNG files were decoded and actually viewed with functions.read(image/png). Renderer commit acknowledgements and exact color pixel counts are corroboration only, not substituted for image observation.

comparison.supported: On the actual owned desktop renderer, identified A and B have visibly distinct stable gold/cyan colors while uncertain crossing and unavailable returning-source text remain gray. The candidate does not display one job/card per recognized token: A and B coherent spans and the whole ambiguous returning run appear as groups.
comparison.retained_ambiguity: hair. is still an isolated gray crossing-word row. The ASR corruption He the He He the detritus remains. A/B labels do not establish real speaker/model accuracy or lexical/semantic correctness.
comparison.not_supported: No claim of elimination of all displayed confusion, overall ASR/translation/profile quality, HMD/photon output, profile robustness, live application timing, or #217 aggregation quality. No usability participants or VR rendering were tested.

attempts.result: Shell consumed unquoted Windows backslashes; executable not launched. Switched exact command to forward-slash paths.
Task-local driver relative input path normalization failed before GUI startup. Resolved input paths in driver.

Owned checkerboard matching used Windows venv launcher PID, not actual child window PID. No capture. Owned process stopped; later exact spawned-driver command-line inspection found no remaining backdrop process. Replaced identity assumption with child-reported actual PID and graceful stdin shutdown.
Actual renderer started and committed source, but strict foreign-window intersection guard rejected capture at origin. Zero images; both own GUI processes stopped.

Reasserting only own topmost HWNDs retained strict guard rejection: a foreign visible 1x1 rectangle at [0,0,1,1] intersected the origin crop. Zero images. Moved only owned fixture/renderer to [32,32] rather than bypassing guard or touching foreign window; both own processes stopped.
Seven safe actual client-crop PNGs captured, then all seven decoded/viewed using functions.read.

remaining_gaps: Actual renderer-only source presentation is now exercised; full live application translated presentation and HMD output remain intentionally unexercised.
Crossing-word gray and original semantic corruption remain visible and are not suppressed or relabeled.
